g.text: Market Desk | live import and independent reminder action
Spring rolls back catalogue, observations and price events together.
Spring commits before the caller receives success.
SAMPLE replacement skips tracking and live alerts.
Unchanged values add no history; an armed target may still evaluate
the fresh LIVE price without a retained observation.
Unknown gaps, expired history and new periods cannot support a drop.
Drop events snapshot both prices and their retrieval times.
Daily summary: GET /alerts or scheduler while app runs
Include unread, unsummarized, currently eligible price events.
Quiet hours and snooze delay availability.
A catch-up summary uses its actual generation time.
Reopening before today's schedule can catch up a missed earlier run.
Default: null retailer keeps the list item in Automatic lowest mode.
The estimate uses the lowest current known listing.
A pinned retailer uses that retailer's price.
Quiet hours do not block a manual add.
Only clear / snooze changes the reminder schedule.
Grouped Tracking / Alert lifeline represents two actual services.
CatalogService delegates input to ConsumerCouncilSourceClient and CatalogJsonParser.
NotificationScheduler is the alternative caller for the daily summary check.
Retrieval time and alert generation time differ; source price date is unknown.
A closed app collects no prices and delivers no notifications.
